items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1971-07-09
items.q: The name 'Dave' appears only in the interviewer's closing remark: '[INTERVIEWER] Thank you so much, Dave.' The interviewee does not mention Dave, nor does he respond to Dave directly in a way that establishes a personal relationship.

ctx.x: D dear And if you don't dig Armstrong, well, you need Joe. You know, like you go somewhere and sit on a couch and let the man examine your head. And you come out of a certain period where you had to do certain things, like, which is not torment, mugging, they called it. See, and you're mugging and you went through the gyrations of face and the mannerisms that went with a certain period. And you can't jump a period and change your style.
